The '''ND-47 ''Stalwart''-class bulk freighter''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] manufactured by [[Nova-Drive]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

Designed as an escort for military naval groups, the ND-47 ''Stalwart'' has a flat, thin design, along with strong shields and tough armor, that allows it to function as a makeshift shield for other ships that have had their shields or armor compromised. Its armor and shields also allow it to transport explosives and supplies in safety. The ND-47 has no stock armament. However, it's design means it has a narrow profile when approaching or fleeing enemy forces, making it a difficult target in battle.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
